description: Source code for WebSocket frame parsing, including header decoding and payload processing.

classes.name: WebSocketFrameParser
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding WebSocket frames, including header and payload parsing.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes incoming data into WebSocket frame chunks, handling incomplete headers and payloads.

methods.name: DecodeFrameHeader
methods.description: Decodes the WebSocket frame header from a data span, extracting flags, opcode, payload length, and masking key.

methods.name: DecodeFramePayload
